updates.note: Reiterated hiring target of approximately 20,000 college graduates for the full year.
updates.quote: For the full year, our target remains clear at approximately 20,000, so around 20,000 like last year.

updates.note: Revenue growth guidance revised downward to 1% to 2% YoY in constant currency.
updates.quote: our revenue growth guidance is 1% to 2% YoY.in constant currency terms.

updates.note: Operating margin guidance maintained at 20% to 22% for the year.
updates.quote: Our operating margin guidance remains at 20% to 22% for the year.

updates.note: Effective tax rate expected to be in the range of 29% to 30%.
updates.quote: We expect effective tax rate for the year to be in the range of 29% to 30%.

updates.note: Target of 6,000 FDEs over multiple years reiterated.
updates.quote: What I think we had shared was the 6,000 was over the multiple years, and that is exactly how the planning is going right now.

new_promises.statement: The net new mega deal is expected to contribute over 1% growth in FY28.
